question.text: When <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of benzoic acid is dissolved in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of water, the freezing point of solution was found to be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>93</mn><mo> </mo><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></msub><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>86</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>mol</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>.
